note: This file was assembled BY HAND. Luma exposes no export and no API on this calendar, so there is no upstream to re-derive it from. 28 of the 42 events below appear on NO public surface — the Luma calendar's own past view lists 14. If this file is lost, those 28 events are gone. Nothing detects drift from Luma, by design: past events do not change, and the live calendar owns upcoming events via the iframe on /events. Titles are normalised on entry, three ways, each one ruled rather than inherited: Luma's own titles carry emoji (🌟, 🚀) and these do not; five ALL-CAPS rows were title-cased; and the "(AICV)" suffix was dropped from the AI Super Users rows, which is AICV's own site and did not need saying.
